sentences.text: I stayed inside the warmth of the coffee shop from 8 PM until 10 PM sharp.
sentences.pressResponseText: Are you sure about the timing? Yes, the grandfather clock was right above my seat.

sentences.text: The weather was completely pleasant and dry when I strolled back home.
sentences.pressResponseText: I wore my lightest clothes; there was no rain whatsoever.

sentences.text: I never touched or carried an umbrella throughout the whole evening!
sentences.pressResponseText: Why would anyone carry an umbrella on a dry night?

sentences.text: After that, I rode my bicycle peacefully back to my flat.
sentences.pressResponseText: My bicycle is stored safely in my apartment lobby.
